evidence_classes.SOURCE-TRACED: read from the disassembly of the cited routine; byte regions hashed in `routines`
evidence_classes.EMULATED: observed in a whole-game run of the original ROM in the approximate SMS harness (named fixtures)
evidence_classes.CONTROLLED: an original routine executed alone with explicit RAM
evidence_classes.REUSED: accepted earlier Research, cited and not re-derived

ram.name: menu
ram.role: title/menu state flags (bit7 start requested, bit6 title active, bit5/4/3 attract and option sub-states); non-zero suppresses the HUD and the level timer

ram.name: flow
ram.role: main-loop dispatch flags: bit7 end path $1365, bit6 level frame enabled (0x40 = playing), bit5 act complete $14AE, bit4 zone complete $1543, bit2 life lost $15F2, bit1 level (re)load $1673, bit0 pause $1696

ram.name: mode
ram.role: stage mode: bit7 special stage active, bit6 success $183F, bit5 failure $1815, bit3 entering

ram.name: started
ram.role: $FF once a game has been started from the title/character select (or hidden level select); cleared by $2C17 when START is pressed on the title; gates the zone/act reset inside $2A00

ram.name: saved_zone
ram.role: zone to restore after a special stage

ram.name: zone
ram.role: zone: 0 THZ, 1 GPZ, 2 SEZ, 3 MGHZ, 4 AQZ, 5 EEZ, 6 end-of-game, 7 title, 8..12 Special Stages 1..5
ram.writers: $07CF new game, $15D6 zone complete, $1870 stage return, $1897 stage entry, $06CD title, $2A27/$2BE8 restart paths, $2C55 attract, $0821 hidden level select

ram.name: act
ram.role: act index 0..2 (Act 1..3); unguarded +1 at $1538 on every act complete and every special-stage return

ram.name: lives
ram.role: lives, packed BCD; game over when the post-death value is 0 (the life being played is part of the count)
ram.writers: $355D init (3 Sonic / 5 Tails), $15FB (-1 DAA), $3113 (+1 DAA, cap $99), $13D4 continue restore (3 Sonic / 5 Tails)

ram.name: rings
ram.role: rings, packed BCD (wraps 99->00 at $3138)
ram.writers: $3138 +1, $4AC8 +$10 (monitor), $A9C5 sign prize +$10 (carry dropped, no award), $2A50 level load (=0), $2D15 tally (-1), $4937 hurt (=0)

ram.name: score
ram.role: score, 3 bytes packed BCD little-endian (D29D units/tens, D29E hundreds/thousands, D29F ten-thousands/hundred-thousands); HUD draws these six digits then a fixed block at name-table $3BA6 (display = raw x 10 is probable, glyph not decoded)

ram.name: bonus
ram.role: end-of-act time/ring bonus word consumed by the tally (+1 raw per step); set by the sign child $19 (0C:$AB52), the boss bonus object type $0A (0C:$9C96) and by the stage success callback ($94BD: seconds left << 8)

ram.name: continues
ram.role: continues in bits 0..6 (mixed binary/BCD increments), bit7 = 'a continue was just used' (cleared by $13ED, set by $1491)
ram.writers: $3561 init (0 Sonic / 3 Tails), $26C9 score award, 0C:$A9D6 sign prize, 1E:$94C2 stage success, $1491 consume, $13ED clear bit7

ram.name: character
ram.role: 1 = Sonic, 2 = Tails (the select cursor 0/1 is held here until $30C5 increments it)

ram.name: emeralds
ram.role: Chaos Emerald bits: $01/$02/$04/$08/$10 = Special Stages 1..5, $20 = sixth (EEZ)
ram.writers: $2A1F cleared by new game, 1E:$94A7 (|= stage bit), 1E:$BB69 (|= $20)

ram.name: result_card
ram.role: results card selector: 0 ordinary, 1 stage failure card (also marks 'stage entered'), $FF stage success card; cleared by $33D7 when the card is drawn

ram.name: timer
ram.role: D2BE run flag ($FF running, 0 stopped); D2C2 frame ticks 0..59; D2BF seconds BCD; D2C0 minutes BCD; counts UP in acts (10:00 sets D44B=$C0 and stops), counts DOWN from 59 in a special stage
ram.writers: $27EE tick, $2965/$296C reset on load, $1753 stop, $1758 start, 0C:$A8A8 sign contact stop

ram.name: timeover
ram.role: $C0 set at 10:00; bit6 makes the player update call the death routine, bit7 makes the life-lost path show the TIME OVER screen

ram.name: powerup
ram.role: power-up id (player object field +$32) and D44C timer; inside the object RAM block $D300..$DBBF that $297E clears on every level load

ram.name: continue_screen
ram.role: continue countdown: D2CA frame ticks (0..$73), D2CB digit 9..0 (underflow to $FF ends the screen)

ram.name: hidden_menus
ram.role: bit0 level select unlocked, bit1 sound test unlocked (title input codes at $0D02 / $0D0B); not a normal-play path

D293.6: level frame enabled (cleared by $166E when no lives are left -> $138A)

palette_fade_answer.question: Is there a palette fade or other transition after the Special Stage results tally and before the next ordinary act loads?
palette_fade_answer.answer: YES - PROVEN (source-traced + emulated): the Special Stage return runs the ordinary act-clear tail `$14AE`..`$153E`, so after the tally returns the ROM waits 48 frames, requests the fade slots D492/D494 (`$1507..$1517`), waits 96 frames, fills the palette buffer (`$342A`), resets the slots (`$1CAF`), waits 48 frames and only then increments the act (`$1534`) and reloads (`$1673`). The summed CRAM brightness steps up to full white (288) in three 5-frame steps and then down to black (0) in three steps before the act increment; the loader then fades the new act in.

clear_thz1_rings00.origin: frames relative to the $14AE act-clear sequence entry

special_stage_success.origin: frames relative to the $14AE act-clear sequence entry

special_stage_timeout.origin: frames relative to the $14AE act-clear sequence entry

caveats: CRAM is written by the ROM's own palette routine; the harness VDP is approximate, so the exact frame offsets of CRAM visibility are EMULATED (the 48/96/48 waits are source-exact).
Brightness is the sum of the 32 CRAM entries' 2-bit channels (0 = black, 288 = all white): it proves a fade to white then black, not the exact palette colours of each step.
The fade BEFORE the results card (act-clear white flash and results fade-in) is separate and was already known.
